title: 환경정책기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20251001:00004:part:1/1

Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Environment and its Affiliated Institutions) <Item 1, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation. However, if any supplementary decrees promulgated before the effective date of this rule are amended in accordance with Article 6 of this appendix, they shall take effect from the date of their original promulgation.

Articles 2 to 5 are omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Decrees) Items ① to <97> are omitted.

<98> The following amendments are made to part of the Rules for the Implementation of the Basic Act on Environmental Policy:

Article 2, Article 3, paragraph 3, Article 4, paragraph 1, item 2, the same paragraph, paragraph 2, and Article 5, paragraph 3, and Article 6, paragraph 1, item 2 and the same paragraph, paragraph 2, shall be changed to "Minister of the Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Environment."

Article 2 shall be changed to "Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Environment Internet Homepage."

Items ① and ② of Article 7 shall be changed to "Ministry of Climate, Energy, and Environment Decree."

Forms 1 and 2 in Appendix.

"Minister of Environment" should be changed to "Minister of Climate and Energy Environment."

In Appendix 1, Form 1, the procedure should be changed to refer to "the Ministry of Environment" as "the Ministry of Climate and Energy Environment."
